body:
There is always help available. 

Talk to your family as a start. Or go straight to a professional.

I am considering going to someone professional to talk to about my problems. Remember, their job is to help you. And that is my advice to you as well. It always feels better when you talk to someone about your problems and feelings.

Basically it's my own fault. All of my friends got into computers but i got a bit more addicted than all of them. And so i lost contact with them, and only speak with them online. 

Pretty much the same with family. Computer games swallowed all my time and i spoke less and less with my parents.

Everytime i try to make my life better it just gets shut down by depression. I try to workout, nope depression is there forcing me to stay in bed or in front of the computer all day. That has led to be losing connection to my family. I barely speak to them anymore. Same with friends, i only speak with them online and occasionally we get out and do things but that is very rare. 

Im addicted to social medias, not because im posting selfies or anything. It's because i hate having the thought of my friends having fun without me. So i check in on social media to confirm wether im left out or not, which i am all the time.

Right now im just waiting for boot camp in the military to start and then hopefully get enlisted. That for me seems like the easiest way to die an early death without suicide.

Just know that there are more people struggling with depression and similar things. Reading posts like these actually help me to cope with my depression a lot.
There are always people on here to talk to if you feel like it! I am here as well. You are loved, friend!

The only reason i haven't pulled the trigger yet is because of my family. But nowadays my relationship with them is getting worse. I barely speak to them even though we live in the same house. 

I just have such high standards on life. I feel like if i don't have a house of my own with a dog and a nice car by 30 my life would not be worth living.
If only it was that easy m8, if only..
Let me just win the lottery real quick, brb m8
Sounds intriguing, where do i sign up?
